ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity (white) to 35% low-intensity (black/dark grey) across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields on the lateral lobes; central black pigmentation forming a wide, branching 'butterfly' shape extending from the peduncle junction; significant high-frequency black-and-white mottling at the internal pigment boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 55-65 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-to-moderate frequency serrations along the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits several small discrete V-shaped notches; left lobe shows more continuous linear topography with minor pixel-level variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curve transitioning into sharp, upwardly-tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized, high-density clusters of circular, high-intensity pixel formations (barnacle colonization) concentrated heavily on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, low-intensity (dark) linear tracks or 'rake marks' oriented vertically on the white distal regions of both lobes, particularly prominent on the lower-left and center-right quadrants.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the fluke tips causing visible structural thickening and textural deviation from the primary fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple low-profile, medium-intensity blobs in the foreground water corresponding to the heads of numerous pinnipeds (seals/sea lions) surrounding the surfacing fluke.
